name: io.github.lvpiggyqq/xcatcher
title: Xcatcher — Recent X Posts
description: Fetch recent X posts by handle via MCP, with JSON and accountless x402 v2 USDC on Base.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Xcatcher API key for account tools. Discovery and direct x402 tools work without it.

headers.name: Accept
headers.description: Request JSON responses from the stateless Remote MCP server.

capabilities.input: 1-500 named X account handles per task
capabilities.output: Paginated native JSON or authenticated XLSX
capabilities.access: Accountless x402 v2 per crawl, or scoped API-key account

modes.normal: Small latest-post snapshot; 1 point per handle
modes.deep: Deeper per-handle pull; 10 points per handle
